title: Why your data is worth more than your salary

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Your data is being sold every time you scroll — and it's worth way more than your paycheck.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Right now, companies are using your habits, preferences, and even your location to make billions.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Your personal data is the most valuable asset in the tech industry today.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Big tech firms like Meta and Google collect and sell your data to advertisers for millions of dollars.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects everyone — from the apps you use to the ads you see and even your job opportunities.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Your data is more valuable than you realize, and it's being used constantly.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: So, what are you going to do about it?
